_comment: What GitHub Copilot CLI was SEEN to fire, not what its documentation names. Documentation says what an event is called; a receipt says what actually ran, and only both together close the gap that makes a wrong event name silent. Captured 2026-09-01 from one session that submitted a prompt, ran a tool and ended, with a probe plugin installed the way a user installs one.
note_on_casing: Each of these also fires under its camelCase name (sessionStart, userPromptSubmitted, preToolUse, postToolUse, agentStop, sessionEnd), and the casing decides the PAYLOAD field names: PascalCase delivers session_id/tool_name/transcript_path, camelCase delivers sessionId/toolName/transcriptPath. This plugin registers PascalCase, so its field map is Claude Code's.
